`config.json` is a team config as Claude Code 2.1.288 writes it to
`~/.claude/teams/<team>/config.json` (fields from its code; not captured from
a run). The lead's entry has `tmuxPaneId: "leader"`, an in-process teammate
`"in-process"`, a split-pane teammate its tmux pane id. Draft 2026-10-03.

`teammate-argv.txt` is a split-pane teammate's command line as `ps` shows it.
